lab.name: Research Laboratory
lab.description: A sterile lab. Fluorescent lights buzz overhead. Benches are covered in abandoned experiments. There is a keypad-locked door to the north.

north.locked_message: The door is locked. A keypad panel blinks red beside it.

hallway.name: Exit Hallway
hallway.description: A bare concrete hallway. The exit sign glows green at the far end.

science_book.name: research journal
science_book.description: A worn research journal left open on a bench. Most of it is dense equations, but on the inside cover someone has scrawled in red pen: 4791.

beaker.name: beaker
beaker.description: An empty glass beaker. Nothing useful inside.

keypad.success_message: The keypad beeps green. A lock disengages with a heavy clunk.
keypad.failure_message: The keypad buzzes red. Incorrect code.

win_condition.message: You sprint down the hallway and burst through the exit. You're free!
